items.title: 68191_William (Bill) H. Challis Oral History Interview
items.q: I'm not had another guitar player... I couldn't get in touch with -- I couldn't (Bucky Pizzarelli -- ed.) get Bucky because he's busy

ctx.x: 1974, I'd say at least 1973 that was working, because I'm not had another guitar player, and had to work that out, and I couldn't get in touch with -- I couldn't (Bucky Pizzarelli -- ed.) get Bucky because he's busy so I had to piece a couple of things here, piece a couple of things here and work on it, gradually, over and over and over and I finally got the things together, and let's see, the Wein thing came up about that time, I think.
